facts.text: Kumail's one-man show about his family
facts.why: The plot has Kumail doing standup sets, an audition and a new set. No one-man show about his family.

vibe.verdict: Right family kitchen and good Pakistani and Chicago food, but it misses the hospital, the comedy and the parents' big turning points.

ideas: Swap 'Chicago deep dish sausage pizza' note ('Kumail and Emily's Chicago') for the night Emily's parents join him at her apartment.

Rename the lassi note to a nod to the Montreal audition (the night Emily got worse).
Add a 'Surprise guest' place card on the tray so the cue pays off visually.
